subject: SignalBridge renewal — executive concession approval request
messages:
From: Naomi Feldman <naomi@redwood.ai>
To: Lukas Meyer <lukas@signalbridge.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>, Dev Patel <dev@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-06-28T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: SignalBridge renewal — executive concession approval request

Lukas — thanks again for taking the call this morning. Quick summary and an ask for internal approval: SignalBridge (DB-4872) is at renewal this July (current ARR: $420,000, current term expires 2027-07-31). They experienced two incidents in Q1–Q2 that materially impacted their ingestion pipeline; they’re evaluating alternatives and have indicated price + stronger SLA protections would keep them on-platform.

We need an executive concession to keep them: proposed package we want to offer conditional on signature by 2027-07-05:
- One-year term reset to 12 months starting on renewal date
- 30% one-time concession off list pricing for first year
- $30,000 service credit (applied as invoice credit) to address the Q1 outage impact
- SLA addendum: 99.9% target with a 10% service credit for any quarterly miss for the next 12 months

Attached: SignalBridge_Renewal_Proposal_v2.pdf (redlines and final pricing).

Why approve: retention keeps $420k ARR, upsell pipeline into SignalBridge product teams (~$150k over 12–18 months) is likely with continued stability work; loss risks churn and competitive switch costs that would be >2x the concession. Ben has run the econ sheet and shows net present value still positive with concession.

Ask to internal leadership (Ben/Dev/Vivek): please confirm whether you can approve the requested package (or an adjusted counter) so I can get this over to Lukas today. If we need formal exec memo for finance/legal sign-off, I can draft in parallel.

—
Naomi Feldman
Account Executive, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference
naomi@redwood.ai
Attachment: SignalBridge_Renewal_Proposal_v2.pdf
From: Lukas Meyer <lukas@signalbridge.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi@redwood.ai>
Cc: Maya Singh <maya@signalbridge.com>
Date: 2027-06-28T11:46:00-07:00
Subject: Re: SignalBridge renewal — executive concession approval request

Thanks Naomi — appreciate the quick summary. Two clarifications before we proceed:
1) The 30% concession is a good start, but given the operational impact we saw in March ( ~4 hours downtime, downstream billing errors) we were hoping for either a larger credit or a multi-quarter SLA guarantee.
2) We need the makegood/credit applied on the first invoice post-renewal and visible on the invoice PDF — our finance team requires that for reconciliation.

Time is tight — our procurement window closes 2027-07-06. Can you confirm final terms and whether Redwood legal will accept the SLA addendum language in the attached draft? Also send the econ sheet so our CFO can see retention math from your side.

Best,
Lukas
VP Operations, SignalBridge
lukas@signalbridge.com
From: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.ai>, Naomi Feldman <naomi@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-06-29T08:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: SignalBridge renewal — executive concession approval request (internal recommendation)

Vivek — Naomi flagged this with me. I ran the numbers (see attached). Recommendation: approve a concession package to close and avoid churn. Specifics: 
- Approve up to 30% off list for year-1 (as Naomi requested)
- Approve $30k invoice credit applied on first renewal invoice
- Approve SLA addendum as written (99.9% target + 10% quarterly credit on miss) for 12 months
- Require a 12-month reset and a one-time non-renewal notice clause (60 days) to avoid open-ended exposure

Economics: net ARR impact year-1: ~-$126k (concession). But retention preserves $420k + expected $75k expansion in 12 months (net positive over 18 months). Churn risk modeled at 60% if we don’t act.

Attachment: save-plan-econ-sheet.xlsx

If you’re okay with the above, I recommend we produce an executive exception memo for finance/legal and send an updated proposal to SignalBridge with a DocuSign link for signature. I can own the econ memo for finance.

—
Ben Carter
Director, Strategic Accounts
ben@redwood.ai

Thanks team — I reviewed Ben's worksheet and Naomi's context. Approve the concession package with the following controls: 
- Limit concession to the single renewal term (12 months) and include an explicit non-renewal remediation clause
- Finance to confirm credit treatment (invoice credit vs. cash refund) — Ben, please coordinate with finance and route the authorization memo to legal.
- Require SignalBridge sign the SLA addendum and the concession terms via DocuSign (no verbal approval).

Ben/Naomi: please generate an authorization-memo for finance/legal (brief, single page) and request Sales Ops to create the DocuSign envelope. Sending the link to Lukas now with the approved terms.
